summary:
Implementation plan for Version 8.9 of PV-Planung Pro:
1. Interactive Level-1 Dashboard Tiles & Active Consumers: Tapping any KPI tile (PV, House Load, Battery, Grid) or any Active Consumer row jumps directly to the Level-2 Telemetry Chart with that curve focused/soloed (including intraday history sampling for individual consumers).
2. Out-of-the-Box Technical Redesign of Level-2 Intraday View: Full-bleed minimalist oscilloscope/telemetry canvas at the top with live crosshair HUD readout and dynamic area gradient fill, paired below with a compact 3-column grid of technical channel cards showing live power (W/%), daily energy (kWh), and peak power (Wmax).
3. Zero-Helper Sankey & Monthly Energy Engine via Lifetime Total-kWh Counters (total_increasing) + Watt-Integration Fallback: Computes Today, Month, and Year energy flows directly from standard lifetime meter readings (Delta = End - Start via HA History API & local snapshots) with automatic trapezoidal Watt-integration fallback when no kWh counter is configured.
